messages:
Alex: FYI after last night's infra window in eu-south-1 (MLNX_OFED 5.9.2 + kernel 6.2.14) we're seeing large variance in NCCL allreduce throughput across p4d pools. Some jobs are fine, others are ~50% slower.

Priya: saw the same on two clusters. Example: 32x allreduce used to be ~20GB/s, now oscillating 8-15GB/s and some ranks hit ~2-3GB/s intermittently. Started around 23:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: ofed-5.9.2 rollout -> eu-south-1 at 22:58 UTC (canary->region)

Chen: ran nccl-tests on one affected rack:
```
# baseline (pre-window): Allreduce 128MB  19.8 GB/s
# after:                     Allreduce 128MB  11.3 GB/s (per-rank variance high)
```

Alex: queued ucx_perftest and ibv_rc_pingpong. pingpong latency normal (~1.2us) but rc_bw and ucx_perftest show skewed per-peer bandwidth.

Priya: grabbed dmesg from node p4d-b2, lots of mlx5 messages around the timeframe: 
```
mlx5_core 0000:04:00.0: CQE: out-of-order completion on qpn 0x7f
mlx5_core 0000:04:00.0: FW message: MC_TIMEOUT on port 1
mlx5 0000:04:00.0: mlx5_core: firmware event, resetting device
```

Chen: counters look odd too (/sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/1/counters):
```
port_xmit_data: 9.1e11
port_recv_data: 4.6e11
rx_discards: 28
rx_crc_errors: 0
```

Alex: no CRCs but discards non-zero again. Could be a driver/kernel interaction that changes completion handling or pacing.

Priya: quick experiment: toggled MLX5 scq/striding_rq (disabled) and reran nccl-tests on one node. Throughput improved ~20% but still below baseline and variance persists.

Chen: NCCL logs show repeated "NET/IB: unexpected CQE" and occasional "NCCL WARN CPU_PROXY" messages. UCX logs show endpoint flush timeouts for some ranks.

Alex: infra-bot, alert details?

infra-bot: alert: cluster:eu-south: nccl_bandwidth_degradation (threshold 25%) triggered at 23:52 UTC — affected nodes: p4d-*-b{1..4}, sample jobs impacted: training-job-3345, hf-train-22

Priya: created INFRA-1167 and attached nccl-tests, ucx logs, dmesg, ethtool -i outputs. Tagging @vendor-sr.

vendor-sr: opened SR with vendor at 00:10 UTC — included per-node logs, firmware/driver versions, kernel config, and perf traces. Vendor requested a reduced reproducer and suggested toggling RX/TX checksum offloads and RSS moments.

Chen: ethtool -i on p4d-b2 shows: driver: mlx5_core, version: 5.12.0-mlnx, firmware-version: 17.16.1040, bus-info: 0000:04:00.0

Alex: interesting firmware differs slightly between racks; some racks still on 17.8. Running a cross-check to correlate firmware vs. severity.

Priya: temporarily disabled HW RSS on one rack and set kernel module param mlx5_core.x to reduce CQ moderation. Ran ucx_perftest: variance reduced but throughput still ~12GB/s.

Chen: will try a rollback canary to previous OFED/kern pair on two spare nodes (p4d-b3,b4) tomorrow morning and run the same nccl-tests. If that recovers throughput we'll escalate for urgent rollback region-wide.

Alex: agreed hold large distributed prod jobs in eu-south for now and divert to other regions where we didn't roll. Added a temporary guard in scheduler to avoid picking affected racks.

Priya: added an alert rule for per-rank variance > 30% to quarantine nodes automatically and add to INFRA-1167.

vendor-sr: vendor replied: "We see CQE ordering changes in OFED 5.9.x when paired with kernel 6.2.x for certain mlx5 firmware — requesting kernel logs with MLX5_DEBUG=1 and ucx debug traces. Also suggested trying a firmware microcode roll back if available."

Chen: collecting MLX5 debug logs now and starting the rollback canary at 02:05 UTC. Will post results here.

Alex: thanks team. Please paste canary nccl-tests outputs and any dmesg differences. We're prioritizing root cause over blanket rollback but will escalate if canary reproduces clear regression. :white_check_mark:
